ns2:course.label: Intro Kines & Community Health
ns2:course.description: Serves as an introduction to the Kinesiology and Community Health Department and provides an overview of the Kinesiology and Community curricula, areas of study, and opportunities available for a careers in the field. Approved for both letter and S/U grading only. Credit will not be given for both KIN 125 and CHLH 111.
